scripts.dev: bun run db:migrate && wrangler dev --var SITE_URL:http://localhost:3000 --var MAIL_DELIVERY:console
scripts.typecheck: CI=1 bun run cf-typegen && tsc && bun run scripts/check-data.ts
scripts.db:migrate: CI=1 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./seed/reset.sql && bun run db:seed
